meta.name: x-osv
meta.description:
CLI for Google OSV database. Query vulnerabilities for packages, 
scan local projects for vulnerable dependencies.

**Dependency**: This is an x-cmd module. Install x-cmd first (see x-cmd skill).
**Required Tool**: Install osv-scanner for project scanning (see https://github.com/google/osv-scanner).

copy.tagline: 查询软件包漏洞并扫描本地项目依赖
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在开发或部署前检查项目依赖中的已知漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Query package vulnerabilities and scan local project dependencies
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to check known vulnerabilities in project dependencies before development or deployment.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以查询 Google OSV 数据库中软件包的已知漏洞，或扫描本地项目找出有漏洞的依赖。
